_meta.description: Match and squad data for the top 10 European national teams. Each team includes the last 2 friendlies and 3 FIFA World Cup 2026 qualification matches, plus the latest 26-man squad call-up.
sources: Wikipedia (national team results & current squad pages)
_meta.validation: Fixtures, scores, dates, venues and squad call-ups cross-checked against Wikipedia, which mirrors official FIFA/UEFA match records. Advanced per-match stats (possession, shots, shots_on_target, xG) are null where not available from a primary source rather than invented.
